{"sourceType":"ESA Tender Action","sourceSystem":"ESA esa-star Publication","sourcePage":"https://esastar-publication-ext.sso.esa.int/ESATenderActions/filter/open","id":187959,"idEra":25145,"activityNumber":"1000046453","contractNumber":"","tanumber":"1-13547","title":"WORLD AGENTIC ENGINE - WAE","description":"Europe has built world leading Earth Observation (EO) infrastructures, but today's exploitation paradigm remains fragmented and focused on data pipelines rather than integrated intelligence. As a result, transforming EO data into actionable insights is slow, difficult to scale, and poorly aligned with the needs of non space industries. Meanwhile, global digital leaders are advancing rapidly with geospatial foundation models, world models and agentic AI systems that reason across heterogeneous data. Without a comparable European capability, much of the value generated from European EO assets risks being externalised.To address this, the proposed activity aims to prototype a World Agentic Engine (WAE), an agentic, AI driven capability able to orchestrate models, data, and servicesusing a shared semantic layer.
